prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP GOREN adult male charcoal worker with a PRIVATE small plain wooden oval amulet on a cord, middle-aged brown hair and short beard, worn charcoal-grey tunic, faded brown apron, heavy boots, slightly tired but standing on dry ground with empty hands; no invented burns, bandages or cure. Keep the amulet in both directions without religious insignia or magic. MIDDLE WENNO adult male cooling-channel maintainer, sandy hair, clean-shaven, slate-blue short work coat with leather belt and gloves tucked at belt, holding a short simple wooden measuring rod low; not a doctor or armed guard. BOTTOM BURAN adult male charcoal-share keeper, stocky mature man with dark cap, brown wool jacket over ochre tunic, dark trousers and boots, closed personal tally pouch. No contaminated water contact, no wage/ransom payment or fulfilled stock order.
